steps.content: You and Drakeling crash into an obstacle and tumble to the ground. Gold coins shower down like rain, while the ducks below scatter in all directions.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What's happening?!)

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack! 
(Ah! They've fallen down! Quick, let's run!)
The ducks are surprisingly quick on their feet, leaving you both far behind in mere moments before vanishing at the end of the path. Watching their retreating figures, Etti lets out a frustrated cry.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ughh—There are so many obstacles, and those troublemakers are such a pain to deal with. Dammit!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Get back here, you naughty ducks! Just wait till I catch you! I'll teach y'all a lesson—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... they've gotten so far ahead. How are we going to catch up? Should we try flying with Drakeling again?
A glimmer flashes in Etti's eyes. With an "aha," her dejected expression vanishes as a playful smirk spreads across her face.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hehe, have you forgotten who created this game world? The great creator cannot allow such violations of the game rules to occur. So, I shall now unleash the most fundamental power of all—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, you're not gonna...?
Etti flashes a mysterious smile. Suddenly, a soft crackling sound echoes through the air. The world before you begins to rewind and overlap at dizzying speed.
When you open your eyes, you find yourself back at the entrance of the cave where the treasures were first stolen.
And of course, the ducks who had made their daring escape not long ago are back as well, quacking in the confused chaos.

steps.speaker: Ducks
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What in the world just happened?!)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The most fundamental power... Hey, if you can reset the game, why not reset it to before the ducks stole anything? You just wanted to play the chase game, didn't you, Etti...
Etti completely ignores your comment and points outside the cave with a grin. There, the ducks huddle together with the treasure chests, chattering helplessly in confusion.

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack? 
(Is this the dragon's cave?)

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack! 
(What's happening? Why are we back here again?!)

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack quack quack—
(Never mind, let's just run with the chests! We can't run into that dragon again—)

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hehehe—Tremble, you miscreants! The almighty Etti and the great Dragon Knight ${PlayerName} shall bring you to justice. Surrender now!
Etti's paper avatar thrusts out her tiny but determined hands.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Now's our chance! One more time—we won't let them escape this time!!!!!
